hooks.text: 击杀敌人获得六角地图块，可延长路线、改善塔位或闭环阻止传送门继续刷怪
hooks.excerpt: Kill enemies to obtain hexagonal map tiles, match these titles with the existing paths to create longer routes, obtain better building placement options, or close off the loop to stop enemies spawning from the portals.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 塔、防守军队与法术共同编成防线，同时应对来自陆地、海上和空中的敌人
hooks.excerpt: Build towers, recruit armies and learn spells to defeat enemies from land, sea and air.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 高地可扩大塔的射程，天气能够减速或伤敌，元素组合还会触发强力反应
hooks.excerpt: Use the terrain and environment to your advantage, place towers on higher elevations to increase their range in the highland maps, or control the weather to slow down or damage enemies. Combine elements to trigger powerful elemental reactions.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段
